title: NSWP world manifest (/.well-known/nswp.json)
description: Served over https with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, at most 64 KB, fetched without following redirects. Unknown fields are ignored. See spec §7.

items.description: Letters, digits, ., _ and - (1-128 chars); clients skip others with a warning.

endpoint.description: Must be wss://; clients ignore other values with a warning.

airlock.description: Must be https://; clients ignore other values with a warning.

items.description: A listing's coordinate, 30078:<pubkey>:<name>, sold by a key this file names as a publisher of this world. Clients ignore others with a warning.

access.description: The listings a paid world is entered by, at most 8. Left out, the world is free.

items.description: wss:// relay URLs; clients skip others with a warning.

kit.description: The version of the NSWP kit the site was built with. The site's own word: a client may tell a visitor that a world's controls are older than its own, and nothing else is decided by it.
